g.text: 01 / RAS SUITE — BESPOKE TAILORING ERP (FRONTEND)
High-performance tailoring platform with real-time measurement tracking, fabric inventory, and multi-shop workflows.
Built with reactive TanStack Start and Radix UI components for low-latency operational management across floor teams.
TANSTACK START · REACT 19 · TYPESCRIPT · TAILWIND CSS · TANSTACK QUERY · RADIX UI
02 / RAS SUITE — API & ENTERPRISE CORE (BACKEND)
Robust multi-tenant backend engine handling shop-level permissions, supervisor queues, and fabric wastage estimation.
Implements secure JWT authentication, automated inventory transfers, and relational database schema architecture.
LARAVEL 11 · PHP · MYSQL · POSTGRESQL · ELOQUENT ORM · REST APIS · RBAC
03 / RAS SUITE — FIELD SALES & MEASUREMENT INTAKE (MOBILE)
Mobile client enabling sales reps and master tailors to capture custom body measurements and manage orders on the move.
Provides offline-tolerant intake, fabric swatch browsing, and instant supervisor approval notifications.
REACT NATIVE · TYPESCRIPT · OFFLINE SYNC · MOBILE WORKFLOWS · ERP EXTENSION
04 / HEALTHTRACKER (TENA) — OFFLINE-FIRST WELLNESS APP
Modern offline-first health and wellness mobile application built with React Native, TypeScript, and local SQLite data storage.
Features BMI/weight telemetry, menstrual cycle tracking, Ethiopian dietary guides, and local notification alarms.
REACT NATIVE · TYPESCRIPT · SQLITE · HEALTH TELEMETRY · LOCAL NOTIFICATIONS
05 / MEKINAHUB — SMART PARKING FINDER (AI & IOT)
Comprehensive smart parking ecosystem integrating live slot discovery, reservations, and payment processing.
Selected among the Top 10 Capstone Graduation Projects at Bahir Dar University for IoT engineering and UX.
FLUTTER · DART · NODE.JS · PRISMA · MYSQL · SOCKET.IO · IOT SENSORS · BDU TOP 10
06 / COMPILER DESIGN & OPTIMIZATION SUITE
High-performance compiler pipeline featuring custom lexical analysis, tokenization, and AST syntax parsing.
Engineered in C++ with memory-safe AST nodes, symbol table managers, and intermediate code optimization passes.
C++ · COMPILER DESIGN · ABSTRACT SYNTAX TREES · LEXICAL ANALYSIS · OPTIMIZATION
07 / PERSONAL PORTFOLIO & INTERACTIVE UI LABS
Clean, interactive personal portfolio website showcasing software projects, technical capabilities, and engineering philosophy.
Built with responsive web design, fluid typography, dark/light theme dynamics, and accessible component architectures.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · HTML5 · CSS3 · VITE · INTERACTION DESIGN
